title: SyncTray profile file
description: Authoritative per-profile file (~/.config/synctray/profiles/{shortId}.profile.json). Hand-editing this file and saving live-applies through SyncTray's reconcile path. Dropping a NEW file with an unknown, well-formed `id` CREATES that profile (persisted always; the launchd agent installs only when the new profile is `isEnabled` and has all required fields filled in) — creation-via-file is supported, not just editing an existing profile. Keep this file's `properties` in lockstep with SyncProfile.CodingKeys (SyncTray/Models/SyncProfile.swift) — verified by scripts/check-schema-in-sync.sh.

$schema.description: Reference to this schema file. Written automatically; safe to ignore.

id.description: Stable profile identifier. Do not change — a changed id is treated as a different profile.

name.description: Display name shown in the SyncTray UI.

localSyncPath.description: Local folder path synced with the remote.

drivePathToMonitor.description: External drive mount point to monitor (empty if not on an external drive).

additionalRcloneFlags.description: Extra flags appended to the rclone command.

isEnabled.description: Whether the scheduled sync/mount agent is installed. Toggling this installs or uninstalls the launchd agent.

isMuted.description: Whether file-change notifications are muted for this profile.

syncMode.description: Two-way sync, one-way sync, or streaming mount.

fallbackRemote.description: Fallback rclone remote used when the primary is unreachable (empty = no fallback).

fallbackRemotePath.description: Path on the fallback remote (empty = same as remotePath).

fallbackRequiresCacheRebuild.description: Whether primary/fallback use different rclone wire types, forcing a full REMOTE swap on failover instead of an env-var override.

mountBackend.description: Mount backend: kext-free NFS (default) or classic macFUSE.

vfsCacheMode.description: rclone VFS cache mode for mount profiles.

vfsCacheMaxAge.description: How long a cached file is kept since last access, e.g. "168h".

allowNonEmptyMount.description: Allow mounting onto a non-empty folder (macFUSE backend only).

mountAtStartup.description: Whether this mount profile auto-mounts at login/app launch.

streamCacheOnly.description: Mount mode only. Manual Cache Only: mount this profile as a writable union overlay over the VFS cache's data tree instead of streaming from the remote — new files and edits land in the overlay (never touching the cache), already-cached files open at local-disk speed, and partially-downloaded files stay hidden. Files created or changed while in this mode upload the next time the profile switches back to Streaming, or via Upload Now without leaving Cache Only. The mount also enters Cache Only AUTOMATICALLY when the primary remote is unreachable at mount time; this flag only tracks the user's manual choice — the running mount's mode file is the source of truth for which mode (including the automatic ones) is actually active.

pinnedDirectories.description: Directories kept warm in the VFS cache for offline access (mount mode).

warmExcludePatterns.description: Glob patterns excluded from offline warming (mount mode). Applied app-side by the warmer; not emitted into the derived {shortId}.json script config.

syncExcludePatterns.description: "Don't Sync" glob patterns for Two-Way (bisync) and One-Way (sync) profiles — same syntax as warmExcludePatterns: case-sensitive, '*' within one path segment, '?' one character, '**' across segments (e.g. "*.bak", "**/BACKUP/**"). Matched against each file's name and its path relative to the sync folder. Written as rclone exclude rules into a managed block of the profile's exclude filter file; matching files stop syncing in both directions and nothing is deleted. Ignored in mount mode.

rcPort.description: Port for rclone's RC (remote control) API (mount mode).

downloadConnections.description: How many files rclone downloads in parallel — sets the mount's --transfers and the app-side offline-warm concurrency. Higher saturates a fast wired link; 1–2 is faster on Wi-Fi/mesh or a slow remote, where parallel transfers contend and collapse throughput. Clamped to 1–16; omitted defaults to 2.

bandwidthLimit.description: Optional rclone --bwlimit applied to every command this profile runs (mount, sync, bisync). A single rate ('10M' = 10 MByte/s), 'up:down' ('1M:512k'), a bare number in KiByte/s, or 'off'. Empty = unlimited. Caps the shared uplink so a live mount can't saturate the link and stall the local NFS server. Validated to a shell-safe single-rate spec (no spaces); an invalid value is treated as empty.

mountResilient.description: Mount mode only. When true (default), the mount is hardened against a stalled backend freezing Finder: rclone gets '--timeout 30s --contimeout 10s' (vs 5m/1m defaults). rclone's NFS server is local and always answers, so '--timeout' makes a wedged backend return a bounded NFS error for the held RPC in ~30s instead of blocking the reading process for minutes. The mount stays the macOS default 'hard' mount — SyncTray does NOT pass '-o soft' (a soft mount cached an EPERM on a transient stall, which Finder showed as a sticky 'permission denied' until remount; a hard mount self-heals once the backend answers). Set false to revert to rclone's stock 5m/1m timeouts.
